summary: Current implementation satisfies the saved callback recovery plan. The recovered callback foundation includes callback id helpers, enums, durable subscription and delivery models, a new callback migration chained after Alembic head 7b8c9d0e1f2a, idempotent POST/GET /v1/callbacks, repository/service registration and delivery flows, sanitized workspace/operation/merge envelopes, disabled-subscription skipping, deduplicated enqueueing, and retry/failure isolation. The remaining event-type conformance gap is closed: CallbackSubscriptionCreateRequest accepts only workspace.*, merge.*, operation.*, or exact public callback event names, rejects workspace.internal_secret, merge.internal_secret, operation.internal_secret, and uses the same public allowlist for wildcard delivery matching so internal source events are not delivered. Validation passed: focused callback API/service/db tests, Alembic heads and migration graph tests, compatibility callback/events/operations/merge-queue tests, ruff, mypy, full unit suite, workspace profile validation commands, and coverage at 99.01%.
